The client uploads the audio via POST /uploads first and passes the resulting URL.

ticket.create-vote.title: Vote for ticket
ticket.create-vote.description: Vote for ticket Vote for a feature request. `action` controls semantics: `'toggle'` (default) flips the vote, `'subscribe'` is idempotent add, `'unsubscribe'` is idempotent remove. `ticketId` is the ticket id or its number; only feature requests take votes. Emails are matched case-insensitively and stored lowercased. The response carries the request's `status` (customer-facing label, null when not public), `public` flag and `shareUrl`.

ticket.delete.title: Delete a ticket
ticket.delete.description: Delete a ticket Permanently deletes a ticket; this cannot be undone. Also deletes every ticket merged into it as a duplicate, along with all messages, scheduled replies, console/network logs and replay data, and removes the ticket from other tickets' linked lists. Fires the `TICKET_DELETED` webhook. Returns an empty body.

ticket.list-feature-request.description: Get a feature request's roadmap summary Roadmap summary of one feature request: title, a description excerpt, the customer-facing status, the upvote count and the public share link. `ticketId` is the ticket id or its number (`123` or `#123`). ticket.update-await-customer-reply.description: Await customer reply on a ticket Park a ticket as "waiting on customer": set expectsReply and archive it. The customer's next reply automatically un-archives, clears the flag, and resumes any awaiting agent.

ticket.update-close-as-spam.title: Close a ticket as spam (agent verdict)
ticket.update-close-as-spam.description: Close a ticket as spam (agent verdict) CLOSE a ticket as spam (agent/MCP verdict): sets the done status, flags + archives it into the Spam review queue, and suppresses every customer-facing follow-up — no CSAT, no notifications, no knowledge extraction. ticket.update-draft-message.title: Set the composer draft message
ticket.update-draft-message.description: Set the composer draft message Stage a drafted reply in the ticket's dashboard composer. `content` is either a Markdown string (converted server-side to the composer's rich-text format) or a TipTap doc. The draft appears instantly in the composer of everyone viewing the ticket; nothing is sent to the customer. It replaces any previous draft and is cleared automatically when a reply is sent or the draft is dismissed in the composer.

ticket.update-link.title: Link a ticket to another ticket
ticket.update-link.description: Link a ticket to another ticket Creates a bidirectional link between the ticket and `targetTicketId` and returns the updated list of linked tickets. Merged tickets are archived and linked to the main ticket. `shouldMergeTasks` re-parents linked sub-tickets; `shouldMergeContacts` merges the contacts of the merged tickets.

ticket.update-snooze.title: Snooze a ticket
ticket.update-snooze.description: Snooze a ticket Snoozes a ticket for `duration` seconds: sets `snoozedUntil`, moves the status to `SNOOZED` and clears the unread flag. The ticket reopens automatically when the snooze expires.
